This lesson covers Handling Hazardous Substances, part of Foundations of pre - technical studies in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Handling Hazardous Substances together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: learner acquires digital skills when using digital devices to search for information on hazardous

substances.

• Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening and self-expression skills when discussing safe

ways of handling hazardous substances.

Learning to learn: learner develops the skill of sharing learnt knowledge when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous

materials.

7

Values:
Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions as they discuss safe ways of handling hazardous substances in the immediate

environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Disaster Risk Reduction: learner’s ability to identify hazards is enhanced when discussing safe ways of handling hazardous

substances in the immediate environment.

Link to other subjects

Integrated Science: learner enhances knowledge on laboratory safety as they exercise safe ways of handling hazardous

substances.
